findings.claim: [global-dns] without searches=home dropped the DHCP search domain, so short names like firebat would stop resolving. The plan now sets searches=home and says why; r2 and r4 check it, and r4 checks getent hosts firebat.
r4 counted a NetworkManager restart as failure while R1 called it acceptable. r4 no longer mentions a restart, so the two agree.
